name: L-theanine
short: In a meta-analysis of 31 randomised trials (1168 people), no serious adverse events were reported. Small add-on trials with sertraline or risperidone found side effects similar to placebo.
text: In a meta-analysis of 31 randomised controlled trials (1168 participants) comparing oral L-theanine with placebo in healthy and clinical populations, no serious adverse events were reported; safety was assessed by comparing dropout rates and reasons between groups. In two 6- to 8-week randomised trials in which L-theanine or placebo was added to an existing medicine (sertraline in 60 people with major depressive disorder, of whom 50 completed; risperidone in 80 inpatients with schizophrenia, of whom 60 were analysed), the frequency of side effects was comparable between groups. No other interaction data were found in the cited sources.
